failures.description: Soft film separates from rigid liner prematurely; folds in on itself.
failures.mitigation: Redesign kinematics to manipulate film exclusively via rigid liner; delay peeling.

failures.description: Dry-install traps airborne dust and >4 air bubbles; delamination occurs.
failures.mitigation: Integrate positive-pressure HEPA micro-environment and high-durometer rolling elastomer.

failures.description: Film stretches, warps, or suffers tails/nubs exceeding +0.1mm tolerance.
failures.mitigation: Implement active tension-control bed and low-friction slip sheets. Tune blade pressure via firmware.

failures.description: Film applied off-center >0.5mm; blocks camera/speaker cutouts.
failures.mitigation: Implement closed-loop optical registration via Denzel downward vision system.

failures.description: Linear carriage collides with internal enclosure boundaries before completing stroke.
failures.mitigation: Abandon pure linear gantry. Implement articulated/rotational stages folding within the 15-inch Z/Y envelope.

failures.description: Toolpath coordinate frame drifts relative to actual device position.
failures.mitigation: Continuous closed-loop optical fiducial tracking driven by the Denzel vision system.

failures.description: Algorithm attempts to cut isolated internal floating camera holes.
failures.mitigation: Deploy cloud-level gatekeeper to convert all cutouts into edge-connected U-shapes.

failures.description: Frontline worker misloads device, causing collision or misalignment.
failures.mitigation: Poka-Yoke 'Magic Slot' loading bay with self-centering V-blocks and keyed cartridges.

failures.description: Power fails mid-cycle; device trapped inside locked electromechanical clamps.
failures.mitigation: Implement normally-open, spring-loaded mechanical clamps defaulting to an open fail-safe.

phase1.title: Hardware Lock & Data Flywheel (The Fortress)
phase1.strategy: Accept 15-inch constraints. Execute F2 (Smart Films) via dynamic blade pressure.
phase1.moat: Deploy Denzel Protocol in 'inert mode' to build proprietary vision dataset from manual AT&T worker inputs.

phase2.title: Architecture Shift (The Drawbridge)
phase2.strategy: Abandon 15-inch box, $5,000 cost cap, and 75dB limits. Execute F1 (Automation) and F3 (3D Geometry).
phase2.moat: Transition to fully autonomous Class-2 freestanding floor kiosk monitored by specialized Service Network Professionals.
